context_requirements: Active MAPK pathway signaling (mutant BRAF, mutant KRAS, or RTK-driven ERK activity) for ERK1/2 inhibitors to reduce proliferation
p38/MAPK14 expression for p38 inhibitors to suppress cytokine/stress outputs
Intact stress or inflammatory signaling for p38-directed effects
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h in BRAF-mutant A375 or KRAS-mutant A549/HT29
No induction of immediate-early feedback genes such as DUSP4/DUSP6/FOS/EGR1 at 6 h
No G1 or G2/M arrest signature at 24 h
No difference between responsive and non-responsive lineages

evidence.supports: p38 MAP kinase inhibition reduces inflammatory cytokine production
p38 inhibitor SB203580 can enhance ERK/JNK and NF-kB activity, indicating pathway crosstalk
p38 MAP kinase inhibitor suppresses IL-6, IL-8 and MMP-13 transcription
SB202190 promotes TFEB/TFE3-dependent autophagy and lysosomal biogenesis independent of p38

changes: Removed MYC from proximal_up because MAPK inhibition reduces MYC transcription via ERK-dependent ELK1/SRF activity.
Removed EGR1 from proximal_down because MAPK inhibition should decrease, not increase, EGR1; it remains in proximal_up.
Removed DUSP6 from proximal_down because MAPK inhibition induces DUSP6 as feedback; it remains in proximal_up.
Removed MYC from proximal_down because MYC is not a direct MAPK target gene and its direction is context-dependent; it was removed from both lists to avoid contradiction.
Removed EGR1 from proximal_down to resolve duplicate listing with proximal_up.
